name: anti-hall
description: Verify-first guardrails for Codex: an installer for the Codex hook subset (shell-command guards, Stop guards, task discipline, speculation checks, session nudges) plus Codex-native skills including session handover. Pure Node (>= 22), macOS and Linux.

interface.shortDescription: Verify-first guardrails and workflows for Codex
interface.longDescription: Anti-Hall brings verify-first discipline, command/git guards, task reminders, and Codex-native workflow guidance to Codex. Some Claude edit-time and subagent lifecycle hooks have no direct Codex equivalent; those are exposed as skill/workflow protocols instead of pretending to hard-block.
defaultPrompt: Use anti-hall to verify this change before claiming it is done
